_comment: What-to-wear data for the Character style. Each band is keyed by feels-like temperature (°F). Bands are checked low-to-high; use the first band whose max >= feels-like temp. Rain and wind variants are coarse overrides layered on top of the temp band's avatar, not a full second grid. Avatar priority, highest first: specialDays with trigger:"date" matching today > rain > wind > plain band avatar (rain is the more visually distinct condition; if it's windy AND rainy, still show the rain avatar and just add the wind text clause). specialDays with trigger:"manual" only show when explicitly invoked, never automatically.

bands.label: Below zero
bands.outfit: Heavyweight thermal base layers, thick fleece/wool mid-layer, expedition-style parka, insulated or snow pants, insulated waterproof winter boots, heavy gloves/mittens, warm hat, neck gaiter/balaclava; minimize exposed skin

bands.label: Extreme cold
bands.outfit: Heavy thermal base layers, fleece/wool mid-layer, parka, insulated pants, insulated waterproof boots, warm hat, insulated gloves, scarf/neck gaiter

bands.label: Bitter cold
bands.outfit: Thermal base layer, heavy insulated coat, insulated or lined pants, winter boots, beanie, gloves, scarf

bands.label: Freezing
bands.outfit: Thermal base layer, sweater/fleece, insulated coat, warm pants, boots, beanie, optional gloves

bands.label: Very cold
bands.outfit: Warm sweater/fleece, winter coat, long pants, boots, beanie, optional gloves

bands.label: Cold
bands.outfit: Sweater/fleece, insulated jacket, long pants, boots or closed shoes

bands.label: Chilly
bands.outfit: Long-sleeve shirt or sweater, light/medium jacket, jeans, closed shoes

bands.label: Mild/Warm
bands.outfit: T-shirt, jeans/chinos or shorts, sneakers; optional light overshirt

bands.label: Warm
bands.outfit: T-shirt or short-sleeve shirt, shorts or lightweight pants, sneakers, sunglasses

bands.label: Hot
bands.outfit: Light T-shirt, shorts, sneakers or sandals, sunglasses, baseball cap, sunscreen

bands.label: Extreme heat
bands.outfit: Very light T-shirt or tank, lightweight shorts, breathable running shoes or sandals, sunglasses, hat, sunscreen

specialDays.label: Anytime you feel like being 80s
specialDays.outfit: Doc Brown–style white lab coat, retro-futuristic glasses or mirrored goggles, graphic T-shirt or button-down underneath, dark pants, chunky sneakers or boots, optional wild hair and gadget-filled pockets
specialDays.note: Easter egg / override, not tied to a temp band or date. Trigger manually (e.g. a button, a konami-code-style input) rather than automatically.

specialDays.label: Halloween
specialDays.outfit: Pirate costume — tricorn hat with skull and crossbones, eyepatch, ruffled shirt under a brass-buttoned coat, sash, cutlass, boots
specialDays.note: Overrides everything else — temp band, rain, wind — on October 31st regardless of actual weather.

rainVariants._comment: Coarse override: when precipitation is high, swap the band's avatar for the matching rain look instead of the plain one. Only two buckets (cold/warm) rather than one per band.

windVariants._comment: Coarse override, same pattern as rainVariants: only used when it's windy AND not rainy (rain avatar takes priority — see top-level _comment). Two buckets, not one per band.

loading.note: Shown the instant a weather lookup starts, before any data has come back. Referenced directly by app code as avatars/avatar-mystery.png rather than looked up from this file, since it must be usable before outfit-guide.json itself has finished loading.

unused.note: Spare cap+tee+shorts+sneakers look, near-duplicate of warm/hot. Not wired into any band.
Spare dark jacket+pants+boots look, no cap. Not wired into any band.

fashionShowExtras.label: Shhhhh! Dr. Who
fashionShowExtras.note: Runway-only cameo - never selected by getOutfitSelection() for real weather, only appears in the fashion show lineup.
